sentences.text: Hon'Ble
Mr. Justice Javed Iqbal Wani, Judge

Order 
10.12.2024 ORAL 1.

The petitioner in the instant petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution has prayed for the following reliefs:
i. Writ of Mandamus:- Commanding the respondents more particularly respondent Nos. 1, 4 to 6 to issue the indent for the land which has been gifted by the petitioner for the construction of water tank over the land of the petitioner measuring 1 Kanal falling under Khasra No. 28 min situated at Village Ashar, Tehsil Gool, District Ramban. ii. Writ of Mandamus:- Commanding the respondents more particularly respondent acquisition Nos. 2 and 3 to initiate proceedings under Right to Fair and Rehabilitation Act Compensation 2013 of the land measuring 1 Kanal falling under Khasra No. 28 min and pay the same to the petitioner with compensation interest as per the Fair Compensation Act.

iii. Writ of Mandamus:- Commanding the respondents more particularly respondent Nos. 1, 4 to 6 and over the possession of the land donated by the petitioner as per the assurance of the respondent No. 4 to 6 or pay the compensation to the petitioner.
2. According to the counsel for the petitioner, 1 Kanal of proprietary land comprising survey No. 28 min situated at Village Ashar, Tehsil Gool, District Ramban came to be donated by the petitioner herein in the year 2014 in favour of the official respondents free from any encumbrance for the Mohd. sentences.text: purpose of construction of a water tank subject to an assurance that one family member of the petitioner would be engaged/appointed in the respondent department, whereupon grandson of the petitioner, namely, Amir Bhat S/o Lataf Hussain came to be engaged, however, on casual/need basis in terms of order dated 26.08.2014 and though the said grandson of the petitioner continued to work with the respondents, the respondents did not regularise his services despite repeated requests and representations made in this regard, which compelled the petitioner herein to seek compensation of the aforesaid land from the respondents and on their failure even to pay compensation thereof, the petitioner herein was constrained to approach this Court through the medium of the instant petition for redressal of his grievances.

3. Objections to the petition have been filed by the respondents, wherein it is being admitted that the petitioner herein donated the land in favour of the Department pursuant to a gift deed and that the grandson of the petitioner herein came to be engaged by the then Superintending Engineer on casual/need basis without any approval.

It is further stated that since the petitioner herein donated the land without any consideration, as such, the petitioner herein is not entitled to either seek regular appointment for any of his family members or else compensation of land.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

4. In so far as the issue involved in the instant petition is concerned, the same is no more res integra and stands settled by the Division Bench of this Court in WP(C) No. 2670/2019 decided on 31.12.2021, wherein it has been held

that the Right to Property though used to be a fundamental right earlier yet continues to be a Constitutional Right under Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and that no one can be deprived of his property save by authority of law and

the said constitutional right has been acknowledged to be akin to a fundamental right and more importantly a basic human right having observed further that no one can be deprived to his property without procedure prescribed by law and payment of adequate compensation.

5. In view of the aforesaid settled legal position and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the respondents cannot, in law, deny the petitioner herein either the benefit of employment to one of his family members or else payment of compensation for the land utilised by them for the construction of water tank.

6. Accordingly, the instant petition is allowed and by issuance of writ of mandamus, the respondents are directed to either regularise the services of grandson of the petitioner herein against a substantive post in the Department or in the alternative pay compensation to the petitioner herein for the land in question under in terms of the provisions of law in vogue.
The aforesaid exercise be undertaken, commenced and concluded by the respondents within a period of three months from the date of passing of this order.
7. Disposed of.
(JAVED IQBAL WANI) JUDGE Jammu 10.12.2024
Sahil Padha
